newsitem.title: USA: Iridium said to restructure junk bond deal-sources.
newsitem.headline: Iridium said to restructure junk bond deal-sources.

text.p: Iridium LLC is rumored to have restructured its 144a private placement of $750 million in junk bonds expected to price on Thursday, according to market sources.
Iridium has dropped plans to sell a $250 million tranche of zero coupon bonds due to poor market demand, sources said.
Additionally, Iridium has increased price talk on a $500 million tranche of cash-pay bonds to around 13 percent from an initial range of 12 to 12-1/4 percent, they said.
Officials at underwriter Chase Securities Inc declined to comment.
The reduced offering will still include warrants to purchase around one percent of Iridium World Communciations Ltd, Iridium's publicly traded subsidiary, sources said.
Originally, the company planned to distribute warrants to purchase 1-1/4-1 to 1/2 percent of the subsidiary among buyers of the $750 million in junk bonds.
An Iridium spokeswoman could not confirm the information.
